newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Q1 car sales down 7.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Q1 car sales down 7.1 percent.

text.p: Sales of passenger cars in the Philippines fell by 7.1 percent in the first quarter of the year to 21,031 units from the year-earlier 22,636 units, the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines said on Tuesday.
For March alone, car sales narrowed by 11.8 percent to 7,126 units from 8,081 in the year-ago month.
The industry group said the decline in sales in March was due to the short working days because of the long Holy Week holidays. It said sales are expected to be recouped in April.
Car manufacturers also experienced a slowdown in sales in January after the sharp increase in sales in December due to aggressive Christmas promotions.
For the first three months, the car sales were led by the unit of Japan's Toyota Motor Co with 3,760 units.
The other leading car firms were the units of Mitsubishi Motors Corp with 3,708 cars; and Honda Motor Co Ltd with 3,719 units.
